edition.authority: Sacred Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith
edition.notes: The official Latin Acta constituent states the Index's continuing moral force, removal of its ecclesiastical-law force and attached censures, the responsibilities of authors, publishers, ordinaries, and episcopal conferences, and the Holy See's continuing authority to reprove harmful works.
edition.title: Notificatio concerning the Index of Prohibited Books

passages.context: The complete notification was inspected for its distinction between the Index's continuing moral force and the removal of its force as ecclesiastical law with attached censures, together with its retained appeal to natural law and continuing ecclesiastical oversight of harmful works.
passages.notes: The passage controls only this notification's legal-force distinction. It does not authenticate previously prohibited works or by itself decide the current force of every separate earlier non-penal command.

alternate_titles: Notification on the abolition of the Index of Prohibited Books
work.author: Sacred Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith
work.description: The notification dated 14 June 1966 declaring that the Index of Prohibited Books retained moral force as an appeal to conscience but no longer had the force of ecclesiastical law with attached censures.
work.title: Notification concerning the Index of Prohibited Books
